name: Terminated Loop
hint: The loop is terminated before it actually repeats (e.g. by a stop-block).
instruction: Please delete the loop or the stop block.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
repeat (10)
go to x: (100) y: (100)
turn left (20) degrees
move(10) steps
stop [this script v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
end
hide
